title_en: ISRO Gaganyaan: Final Uncrewed Orbital Flight Simulation Achieves 100% Human-Rating Validation
title_hi: इसरो गगनयान: अंतिम मानवरहित कक्षीय उड़ान सिमुलेशन सफल, मानव-रेटिंग परीक्षणों में शत-प्रतिशत सफलता
summary_en: Indian Space Research Organisation successfully concludes the integrated high-altitude abort and atmospheric re-entry trials ahead of scheduled crewed spaceflight.

title_en: Supreme Court Constitution Bench Issues Historic Doctrine on AI Surveillance and Algorithmic Privacy
title_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट की संविधान पीठ का ऐतिहासिक फैसला: एआई सर्विलांस और एल्गोरिद्मिक गोपनीयता पर नई लक्ष्मण रेखा
summary_en: A unanimous 5-judge bench establishes strict constitutional limits on predictive policing, facial recognition deployment, and automated administrative scoring.

title_en: RBI Monetary Policy Committee Maintains Repo Rate at 6.50% Citing Robust 7.4% GDP Trajectory
title_hi: आरबीआई मौद्रिक नीति समिति: रेपो रेट 6.50% पर स्थिर, 7.4% की मजबूत जीडीपी वृद्धि दर का भरोसा
source: Reserve Bank of India & Financial Wire
summary_en: Central bank emphasizes disinflation continuity while forecasting sustained industrial expansion and resilient corporate balance sheets.

title_en: Quad Nations Formally Operationalize Integrated Indo-Pacific Maritime Domain Awareness (IPMDA) Radar Network
title_hi: क्वाड देशों ने हिंद-प्रशांत समुद्री निगरानी नेटवर्क (IPMDA) किया सक्रिय, सुरक्षा रडार तैनात
source: Ministry of External Affairs & Quad Secretariats
summary_en: India, the United States, Japan, and Australia interconnect naval satellite telemetry to counter illegal fishing, piracy, and gray-zone territorial encroachment.

title_en: National Green Hydrogen Mission Crosses 5 Million Tonne Electrolyser Tender Benchmark
title_hi: राष्ट्रीय हरित हाइड्रोजन मिशन: 50 लाख टन इलेक्ट्रोलाइज़र क्षमता टेंडर का नया रिकॉर्ड
source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
summary_en: Massive capital allocation and production-linked incentives position India as the lowest-cost green ammonia exporter to Europe and East Asia.

title_en: India Semiconductor Mission Clears ₹38,000 Crore Phase-2 Commercial Silicon Carbide (SiC) Power Fab
title_hi: इंडिया सेमीकंडक्टर मिशन: ₹38,000 करोड़ का दूसरा चरण स्वीकृत, सिलिकॉन कार्बाइड पावर फैब को हरी झंडी
summary_en: Compound semiconductor facility to produce next-generation power chips for electric vehicles, solar inverters, and high-speed rail networks.

title_en: Defense Acquisition Council Accords ₹65,000 Crore Acceptance of Necessity for Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA)
title_hi: रक्षा अधिग्रहण परिषद: स्वदेशी 5वीं पीढ़ी के स्टील्थ फाइटर 'AMCA' के लिए ₹65,000 करोड़ की मंजूरी
source: Ministry of Defence & Press Information Bureau
summary_en: Cabinet Committee on Security paves path for five prototypes of fifth-generation twin-engine stealth fighter with internal weapons bays and supercruise capability.

title_en: Global Macro Watch: Brent Crude Stabilizes at $76 as Extended OPEC+ Discipline Offsets Volatility
title_hi: वैश्विक अर्थव्यवस्था: ब्रेंट क्रूड $76 पर स्थिर, ओपेक+ के संयम से कच्चे तेल की कीमतों में नरमी
source: International Energy Agency & Global Financial Wire
summary_en: Stable energy benchmark provides disinflationary relief for import-dependent Asian economies while international trade balances remain steady.

title_en: CERN Large Hadron Collider Collision Trials Reveal Anomalous Lepton Flavour Symmetry Signal
title_hi: सर्न (CERN): लार्ज हैड्रॉन कोलाइडर के उप-परमाण्विक टकराव में नई भौतिकी के क्रांतिकारी संकेत
source: CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research
summary_en: LHCb and CMS collaborative datasets indicate a 4.2-sigma departure from Standard Model predictions in bottom meson decays.

title_en: Direct Tax Net Collections Surge 18.2% to ₹14.8 Lakh Crore Led by Advance Corporate Tax
title_hi: प्रत्यक्ष कर संग्रह में 18.2% का भारी उछाल, ₹14.8 लाख करोड़ पर पहुंचा शुद्ध टैक्स राजस्व
summary_en: Digital tax compliance, AI-driven evasion detection, and formalization of the enterprise economy boost fiscal deficit consolidation.
